name: Skimo base 60
description: Aerobic base for ski touring: one long steady climb at a vertical rate you could hold for hours. RPE 4-5, full sentences.

ramp.name: Warm-up
ramp.notes: Easy and smooth. Nose breathing, shoulders loose.

steps.name: Steady climb
steps.notes: RPE 4-5. Smooth cadence, short even steps, relaxed arms.

ramp.name: Cooldown
ramp.notes: Let the breathing settle; sip water.
